lesson.concept: When the angle is 90 or 270, the function changes to its co-function. sin(90 - x) = cos x, cos(90 + x) = -sin x. When the angle is 180 or 360, the function stays the same.
lesson.why: This is one of the most frequent errors DBE reported for this section.

work: Angle is 90, so the function changes to cos.
90 - x is in Q1, where sine is positive.

learner_message: You changed the sign but kept the same function. When the angle is 90 or 270, the ratio swaps to its co-function.
